appearance.titleAnimationHint: Show animated terminal title in the CLI.
appearance.languageHint: Changes only the interface text. Prompts, skills, and model output are not affected.

model.notFound: No models found for this provider. The catalog might be empty or still loading.

provider.orEnv: Or set {{env}} in the environment instead.
provider.manageKeys: Manage your API keys and provider configurations

mcp.lazyConnectHint: (don't start until first tool call; auto-sleeps when idle)
mcp.heading: MCP Servers
mcp.recommendedBody: One-click add for popular MCP servers. Click Add to pre-fill the configuration, then confirm. Servers requiring credentials will need their env vars set before use.
mcp.noServersHint: Switch to the Recommended tab to add popular servers, or Add Custom for your own.
mcp.addCustomBody: Configure a custom MCP server with stdio, SSE, or HTTP transport.
mcp.addCustomBodyHint: For popular servers, use the Recommended tab instead — everything is pre-configured for you.
mcp.removeConfirmBody: This removes the MCP server from your configuration.
mcp.disabledHint: Enable the "MCP servers" feature flag in the Features tab to use this section.

allowlist.title: Clear saved allowlist?
allowlist.body_one: This will remove the pinned model for {{provider}}. The model picker will fall back to the models.dev catalog.
allowlist.body_other: This will remove the {{count}} pinned models for {{provider}}. The model picker will fall back to the models.dev catalog.
allowlist.undoHint: You can undo this for 8 seconds after confirming.

oauth.termsWarning: Sign in with a subscription instead of an API key. Using a subscription outside its official client may violate the provider's Terms — your account could be rate-limited or banned. An API key is the sanctioned path for programmatic use.
oauth.waitingBrowser: Waiting for you to sign in…
oauth.pasteLoopbackBusy: Loopback port busy — paste the redirect URL
oauth.pasteCantReach: Browser can't reach this server? Paste the redirect URL
oauth.enterCode: Enter this code at the verification page:

agent.autonomyModeHint: How independently the agent proceeds between turns.
agent.autoProceedDelayHint: Milliseconds before the agent auto-proceeds in Auto mode. 0 = immediate.
agent.yoloHint: Bypass tool confirmation prompts — the agent runs without asking.
agent.enableRefineHint: Rewrite prompts before sending — clearer instructions, better results.
agent.refineDelayHint: Countdown before the refined prompt auto-sends.
agent.refineLanguageHint: Keep your language or translate to English for the model.
agent.reasoningModeHint: Control how the model uses extended thinking. Auto = provider default.
agent.reasoningEffortHint: How much compute the model spends thinking. Only sent when the model supports it.
agent.preserveThinkingHint: Keep reasoning blocks across turns for context continuity.
agent.cacheTtlHint: Prompt cache time-to-live. 1h costs more on write but saves on repeat reads (Anthropic).
agent.capsHint: Use wstack models caps to check what the current model supports. Unsupported settings are silently omitted per-request.
agent.fallbackBody: When the active model rate-limits (429/529), 5xx-errors, or stalls — after its own retries — the agent rotates to the next model in this chain. Also used as the default for SDD worker subagents.
agent.autoFallbackHint: When the chain above is empty, auto-derive one from your keyed providers.
agent.favoritesOnlyHint: When auto fallback derives a chain, restrict it to your favorite models.
agent.favoritesEmpty: Favorites are shown first and can constrain auto fallback.
agent.hqPublishingHint: Publish this WebUI/client session to WrongStack HQ. Same-machine clients can auto-discover local HQ auth; remote clients use the URL/token below.
agent.maxIterationsHint: Hard cap on LLM turns per agent.run().
agent.autoProceedMaxIterationsHint: Stop auto-proceed after N iterations. 0 = unlimited.
agent.confirmExitHint: First Ctrl+C aborts work, second confirms exit.
agent.chimeHint: Terminal bell when an agent run finishes.
agent.streamFleetHint: Show live subagent activity in the fleet panel.
agent.maxConcurrentHint: Maximum number of subagents that can run simultaneously.
agent.nextPredictionHint: After a turn completes, predict likely next steps.
agent.telegramSessionEndHint: Send a summary when a session ends.
agent.telegramDelegateHint: Send a humanized note when a subagent completes.
agent.telegramLongToolHint: Notify when a tool exceeds {{ms}}ms. Set 0 to disable.
agent.telegramNotConfigured: Telegram is not configured. Run /telegram-setup in the CLI to connect a bot first.
agent.hqRawContentHint: Send raw content previews to HQ instead of redacted previews.

features.memoryHint: Persist and recall facts across sessions.
features.modelsRegistryHint: Use the models.dev catalog for provider discovery.
features.indexOnStartHint: Build the codebase symbol index at session start.
features.autoCompactHint: Automatically trim the context window when near limits.
features.compactorStrategyHint: How the context is compacted when it grows too large.
features.contextModeHint: Context window policy — balanced is the default.
features.contextModeDeep: Deep — larger context for complex tasks
features.tokenSavingHint: How aggressively to reduce token usage.
features.auditLevelHint: Detail level for session audit logs.
